description: JAH-TANGIBLE-RECORD/1.0 — canonical record for one Signature Tangible. The permanent tangible ID IS the source record ID (one source record <-> one medallion); meshes are generated deterministically in the browser from that ID, never stored.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical tangible JSON (computed at render/download time).

creation_mode.description: How this tangible came to exist.

downloads.description: Per-format download descriptor. Files are generated in the browser on demand; size/sha256 are computed at generation time and shown on the download buttons.

generated.description: 'browser' — generated on demand in the visitor's browser.

files_stored.description: No mesh files are stored server-side. Ever.

functional_replica.description: This is NEVER a functional replica of the invention described by the source record.

geometry_version.description: Incremented only on intentional geometry changes; never silently.

keychain_available.description: Keychain variant = same medallion + fused loop (5mm hole), selectable on the item page.

mesh_validation.description: Deterministic generator cross-verified Python/JS (code/qa/test_determinism.py). No physical print test is claimed for the archive.

provenance.description: TANGIBLE -> SOURCE RECORD -> SOURCE CATALOG -> SOURCE URL.

record_id.description: Alias of source_id: the permanent tangible ID.

source_id.description: Permanent ID of the source record (JAH-SPEC-######, JAH-PAT-######, or patent publication number).

source_status.description: DRAFT for spec drafts (not filed, not granted); PUBLIC_RECORD for patent records.

title: JAH Tangible Record 1.0
